title: Sherpa-UI DTCG-dialect component spec
description: Private convention (DTCG-inspired grammar: $-keys + {ref} like the token file) for describing a sherpa-* web component. NOT external-DTCG-tool interop. See docs/COMPONENT-SPEC-DTCG-PLAN.md §1.

$schema.description: Points at this schema (or its URL). Free-form string so the file can name where it was validated.

$type.description: The DTCG-dialect node type. At the top level a spec is always a `component`.

$name.description: The code element name — always sherpa-*.

props.description: The public API: data-* attributes + native (bare) attributes.

variants.description: Named visual/state forks the design picks. Each may $ref an extension tier or a prop.

states.description: Each state = a CSS selector + the token {ref}s that selector applies. CSS-owned, JS-free.

capabilities.description: Declared Web-API surface (form-association, ElementInternals, container-query, observers, JS-property mirror, …) so robustness is contract data, not implicit in the .ts.

tokens.description: element.property -> token {ref}. Values are {ref} strings into the token DTCG or this spec.

$extensions.description: Namespaced extras (Figma names, behaviour channel, divergence). Open by design.

typeEnum.description: The closed set of component-spec node types.

ref.description: A DTCG-style reference: {path.to.thing}. Resolves against this spec or the token DTCG via the shared resolver.

refOrValue.description: Either a {ref} or a literal value the CSS uses (e.g. a hardcoded fallback hex or keyword).

element.description: The native element the component IS.

tag.description: The native tag the component's interactive root is (e.g. button).

attributes.description: Native attributes set on that tag in the template (role, type, aria-*, …).

provides.description: Browser-owned behaviour JS must not re-implement (from element-map.yaml provides:).

stateCss.description: CSS-native state hooks: state name -> the selector that drives it (e.g. focus-visible -> :focus-visible).

prop.description: One public attribute of the component.

name.description: The attribute name: data-* (kebab) or a bare native attr (disabled, name, value…).

kind.description: The variant mechanism: how the prop is realised. Native attrs may omit this.

native.description: true = a bare native HTML attribute (disabled, name…), not a data-* one.

values.description: Allowed values for an enum prop.

$ref.description: Binds this variant to a prop or an extension tier via {ref}.

selector.description: The CSS selector that expresses the state (e.g. :host([data-state="on"]), :focus-visible, :host([disabled])).

tokens.description: The token {ref}s (or literal values) the selector applies.

capability.description: A declared Web-API surface the component relies on.

api.description: The capability name (e.g. js-property-mirror, container-query, ElementInternals).

name.description: Unprefixed noun-verb (or a re-dispatched native name like change).

trigger.description: What fires it — the native event + node it comes from.

sherpaExtension.description: Sherpa-namespaced extras. Open so new metadata can be added without a schema bump.

jsProps.description: The JS-property mirror surface (read/write reflected props).

behaviour.description: The Figma behaviour channel — runtime behaviour Figma can't model structurally.

divergence.description: Figma-vs-code divergence, mirrored from the component's thin.yaml _divergence block.
